notes.title: Update 2.1.8 — Multilingual UI Improvements
notes.notes:
The 2.1.8 update focuses on improving the quality of the multilingual UI.



Fixed an issue where button and label text would clip or overlap in some languages

Adjusted text wrapping, alignment, and sizing

Optimized UI image scaling and spacing

Enhanced overall readability and accessibility





We will continue to improve the experience so players across all regions can enjoy the game comfortably.

notes.title: Update 2.1.6 – New Languages & Translation Improvements
notes.notes:
Update 2.1.6 – Windows / Mac

Ukrainian, Turkish, Dutch, and Polish have been newly added.

The quality of existing multilingual translations has been improved.

Dungeon Tracer now officially supports 22 languages: Korean, English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Thai, French, German, Russian, Vietnamese, Swedish, Spanish (Spain), Spanish (Latin America), Arabic, Italian, Indonesian, Hindi, Portuguese (Brazil), Ukrainian, Turkish, Dutch, and Polish.

If you would like to suggest translation improvements, please visit 

https://discord.gg/dungeontracer

notes.title: Update 2.1.4: Skill Description Bug Fixed
notes.notes:
\[Update 2.1.4 Patch Notes]

This update addresses a UI bug related to skill descriptions for a clearer gameplay experience.

Key Changes

Fixed an issue where the previous skill’s description would remain visible after swapping to a new skill

Now the correct description is displayed for the newly equipped skill

Thanks to everyone who reported this issue!
We’ll continue to improve the experience with your feedback in mind.

notes.title: Update 2.1.3: Rogue's Greed Skill Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Update 2.1.3 (2025-07-22)

Fixed an issue where defeating a Lich with the Rogue's Greed skill caused relic chests to duplicate and blocks to overlap.

Thank you to all the players who reported this issue.

notes.title: Update 2.1.2: Auto Select Default & Patch Notes System
notes.notes:
■ Auto Select Default OFF
Auto Select is now turned off by default.
If you prefer the previous behavior, you can re-enable it in the Settings menu.

■ Patch Notes System
You can now view update history directly from within the game.
New updates will show a popup once upon first login.

notes.title: Update 2.1.1: UI & Auto Click Improvements
notes.notes:
\[Update 2.1.1 Patch Notes]

This update focuses on UI fixes and improvements to auto click behavior for a smoother gameplay experience.

Key Changes

Fixed text being cut off on the left side of the guide screen

Adjusted background transparency in some scroll views for better readability

Fixed flickering tooltips for special enemies

Fixed issue where turn would not progress when using a skill during auto click

Added right-click outside the board to cancel auto click

Fixed issue where damage text didn't follow the mouse during auto click

Thank you for playing!
We’ll continue to improve the experience with your feedback in mind.

notes.title: Leaderboard Score Registration Bug Fix (2.0.7)
notes.notes:
Leaderboard Bug Fix Notice (2.0.7)

We've resolved an issue where high scores were **not properly recorded per difficulty level** on the leaderboard.

Fix Details  

- Fixed an issue where high scores were not properly recorded per difficulty level  

- Now, the highest score for (Normal / Hard / Very Hard) is correctly registered on the leaderboard

Thank you for your feedback and support.  

We'll continue to improve the game experience!

notes.title: Demo - Update 1.0.42 – Control Refinement & Difficulty Adjustment
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,



Thanks to your valuable feedback. We’ve made two key improvements in this update:



Control Refinement

The action to confirm auto-link is now mapped to:



Enter key (Keyboard)

B button (Gamepad)





The previous method of double-pressing Tab or RT is no longer supported.



Difficulty Adjustment

We’ve slightly reduced the overall difficulty of the game.

This change is intended to make a wider range of strategies and combinations more accessible to all players.



Please continue testing and let us know how it feels.



Thank you for playing!

Dungeon Tracer – Puzzle Roguelike RPG

notes.title: Demo Update 1.0.40 – Keyboard & Gamepad Support (Experimental)
notes.notes:
🎮 New Experimental Feature – Keyboard & Gamepad Support!

You can now play **Dungeon Tracer** using only your keyboard or gamepad – no mouse required!

### ⌨️ Keyboard Controls

- Arrow Keys: Move between blocks

- Space: Select and connect

- Enter: Confirm

- Tab: Auto-link

### 🎮 Gamepad Controls

- Left Stick: Move

- A: Select and connect

- B: Confirm

- RT: Auto-link

🧪 **This feature is experimental and still in testing.**

The final version may change depending on your feedback.

Please try it out and let us know how it feels!

Thank you for supporting Dungeon Tracer 💙

📢 We'd love to hear your feedback in our Discord 

 👉 

https://discord.gg/VtNbMbzU

notes.title: Demo - Update 1.0.31 – Smart Path Auto-Select Added!
notes.notes:
🆕 Version 1.0.31 Update Notes

A new experimental feature has been added to improve accessibility and comfort!

🖱 Right-Click Auto Select

- Right-click a block to automatically select the longest possible path.

- Right-click again on the same block to cancel the selection.

- Right-click a different block to reset and start from that one.

- Left-click the last block to confirm the path.

- Left-click any block in the middle to adjust the path up to that point.

🔁 If all blocks are the same type, a special zigzag path will be auto-selected (max 18 blocks supported).

💡 This feature is only available in the demo version and is experimental!

🙌 We hope this feature helps reduce wrist strain and makes long sessions more comfortable!



🔧 Additionally, major fixes have been made to the Leaderboard system. It should now work properly, but we need your help to test it thoroughly.

👉 Try it out, and let us know your thoughts on the Community Hub!
